item.title: Chiefs' George Karlaftis donates $10,000 to West Lafayette school program
item.description: George Karlaftis, Kansas City Chiefs defensive end, donates $10,000 to support West Lafayette High School's backpack program, helping students in need.

item.title: Police chase turns to rescue when driver jumps into South Bend river
item.description: A water rescue happened after a vehicle pursuit ended with the driver jumping into the St. Joseph River in downtown South Bend.

item.title: Pistons match historic winning streak, defeat Pacers
item.description: Cade Cunningham's 24 points and 11 rebounds lead the Detroit Pistons to their 13th straight win, tying a franchise record.

item.title: Jesse Jackson out of hospital after 12-day stay for neurological disorder
item.description: U.S. civil rights leader Jesse Jackson has been discharged from a Chicago hospital after receiving medical care for progressive supranuclear palsy.

item.title: Mozel Sanders Foundation gears up to serve thousands on Thanksgiving
item.description: The Mozel Sanders Thanksgiving Day Dinner in Indianapolis serves over 40,000 meals to those in need, continuing a tradition of community support since 1971.

item.title: Teen who planned Valentine's Day school shooting sentenced to 12 years
item.description: Teenager from Mooresville sentenced to 12 years in prison for planning a school shooting. The case highlights the need for mental health support, investigators said.

item.title: Indiana Silver Alert canceled for 15-year-old girl missing from Fort Wayne
item.description: Help Fort Wayne Police find missing 15-year-old Aliyah Difilippo, last seen Sunday evening. She may be in extreme danger and need medical assistance.

item.title: $15 billion in Amazon data centers in Indiana aim to advance AI innovation
item.description: Amazon invests $15 billion in a new data center in northern Indiana, aiming to create 1,100 jobs and advance artificial intelligence innovation.

item.title: Domestic situation leads to fatal shooting in rural Madison County home
item.description: A 40-year-old Elwood man was shot dead in a rural home in Madison County, Indiana. The case is being investigated as a domestic situation.
